title: AEGIS experiment manifest, version 1
description: Everything needed to re-run an experiment and get the same answer (AEGIS-097, AEGIS-209 through AEGIS-216). A result whose manifest is incomplete is not reproducible, whatever the report says.

experiment_id.description: Immutable unique identifier for this run (AEGIS-209).

code_commit.description: Git commit the run executed (AEGIS-210). Recorded, not described: a report that says 'latest main' is not reproducible.

config_digest.description: SHA-256 of the resolved configuration (AEGIS-212). The resolved one, not the file: environment and CLI overrides change what actually ran.

created_at_ns.description: UTC nanoseconds when the manifest was written.

rerun_command.description: The exact command that reproduces this run (AEGIS-216).

data_version.description: Dataset identifier and version (AEGIS-211). Absent only when a run consumed no dataset.

date_range.description: Inclusive ISO dates covered by the run (AEGIS-213).

roll_method.description: Futures roll convention (AEGIS-213). Results are not comparable across roll methods, so it is recorded rather than assumed.

costs.description: Cost assumptions applied (AEGIS-214). A gross-of-cost result reported as net is the single most common way a backtest misleads.
